device.type: DVB-S2X + DVB-T2/C Full HD H.265/HEVC combo receiver with CI+ slot, Conax CA card reader, Gigabit Ethernet and USB Wi-Fi
device.board: 8E000A00 (bootloader version "M3759A 1.0.1", 8 MB SPI flash, ALi C3702 / CAP210 ARMv7-A platform)
device.soc: ALi M3759A / C3702 (ARMv7-A Cortex-A9 CPU, get_clock_cap210 / get_clock_3702, DECV_HEVC_0/1, NIM_C3501h_0 + Availink AVL6862)
device.family: M3801 (chips/m3801.py, NCRC chunk container only; CPU is ARMv7-A rather than MIPS32)
device.demod: internal DVB-S2X (NIM_C3501h_0) + external Availink AVL6862 DVB-T2/C

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive Amiko_HD9265_1.0.15_emu.zip from the Amiko directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Does not boot on the MIPS32 simulator (run_dump_hd9265_arm_layout.py): although the 8 MB image uses ALi's standard NCRC chunk chain (magic 0x23010010 at 0x000000, HEAD descriptor at 0x250, LZMA-compressed maincode(AV) at 0x078000 decompressing to 16.05 MB), the ALi M3759A / C3702 ("get_clock_cap210", "get_clock_3702") is an ARMv7-A (Cortex-A9) SoC rather than MIPS32.  Its boot-ROM payload at 0x800 starts with an 8-word ARMv7 exception vector table (b #0x820; b #0x804; b #0x944; ...) followed at 0x820 by mrc p15, #0, r0, c1, c0, #0 (reading CP15 SCTLR).

desc: Amiko HD9265+ (System ID 8E000A00) firmware v1.0.15 EMU (2019-08-24) for the Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2X + DVB-T2/C CI+ combo receiver on the ALi M3759A / C3702 SoC with 8 MB SPI flash.

Illustrates ALi's transition from MIPS32 (C3503 / C3505) to ARMv7-A (C3702 / CAP210, M3759A) while retaining the identical NCRC chunk header layout, LZMA stream format, and ALi TDS driver naming (CH455_0, NIM_C3501h_0, DECV_HEVC_0).
